name: open-video-harness
description: OpenVideoHarness: a controllable workflow for making videos with code.

plugins.name: open-video-harness
plugins.description: Make videos with code through the OpenVideoHarness workbench: say what film you want, an agent writes the code, renders it, checks it and stops for you at the decisions that are yours. This plugin is the pointer; on first use it asks before installing the workbench.
